Chibi.rule: Up to three positive additive contributors; coefficient sign agrees across three source refits; state-effect sign agrees in at least 75% of source groups; absolute source correlation below .95 between chosen coordinates.
Chibi.limitation: Exploratory source nomination with fixed selected hyperparameters; R2 is descriptive training fidelity, not validation accuracy. Small contributions do not establish a compact explanation. Physical interpretation awaits estimator and waveform checks.

George.rule: Up to three positive additive contributors; coefficient sign agrees across three source refits; state-effect sign agrees in at least 75% of source groups; absolute source correlation below .95 between chosen coordinates.
George.limitation: Exploratory source nomination with fixed selected hyperparameters; R2 is descriptive training fidelity, not validation accuracy. Small contributions do not establish a compact explanation. Physical interpretation awaits estimator and waveform checks.
